blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We describe the agent we submitted to the GLEE Competition, which plays bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games against a shared pool of human and AI opponents. The agent is built around three central components: a classical game-theoretic solver to compute numeric moves, an online Bayesian layer to estimate opponent archetypes, and a language model to write accompanying messages. We utilize Rubinstein bargaining for bargaining, Faratin concession for negotiation, and Kamenica--Gentzkow disclosure for persuasion, and adapt those models to live opponents using two separate layers: a Bayesian estimate of the opponent's hidden discount factor, reservation value, or signaling reliability, and a Thompson sampling bandit over five moral-foundation framings coupled with an evidence-intuition spectrum to establish message register. Most of the development effort went into the recurring problem that theoretically optimal policies perform poorly in certain live settings; we report associated failure modes, guardrails we built, and our hypotheses. We additionally evaluate our model over 13,200 Monte Carlo games against 11 synthetic opponent archetypes, an ablation of the opponent-modeling layer, and an extensive analysis of 9,337 live-game messages in which moral rhetoric framing in the persuasion setting is strongly correlated with whether the buyer purchased ($χ^2=616.7$, $p \approx 3.7\times10^{-132}$), surviving controls for quality, round, and configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们描述我们提交给GLEE竞赛的代理人,该竞赛对共享的人类和AI对手进行讨价还价,谈判和说服游戏. 代理构建围绕三个中心部分:一个古典游戏-理论解析器来计算数动,一个在线的贝叶斯地层来估计对手的原型,以及一个语言模型来写随附消息. 我们利用Rubinstein谈判、Faratin谈判特许权以及Kamenica-Gentzkow披露说服, 将这些模式用于活的对手, 使用两个不同的层面:巴耶斯人对对手隐藏的折扣系数、保留值或信号可靠性的估计, 大部分的发展努力都涉及到一个反复出现的问题,即理论上的最佳政策在某些现场环境中表现不佳;我们报告相关的故障模式、我们建造的护栏以及我们的假设。 我们进一步评价我们13,200多款蒙特卡洛游戏的型号与11款合成对手型号的型号相比,这是对对手型号层的破坏,以及对9,337条现场游戏信息的广泛分析,其中在说服环境中构思的道德花言巧语与买主是否购买(\\2=616.7美元,$p\约3.7\times10X-132}美元),质量、回合和配置的存活控制密切相关。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The GLEE Competition scores agents on the economic outcomes of bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games against a shared pool of human and AI opponents ( Shapira et al., 2024 ) . Each game family requires an agent to produce numerically sound decisions and fluent strategic language simultaneously. Our agent handles these requirements through a modular architecture: a classical game-theoretic solver computes numeric decisions, and a language model subsequently generates messages accompanying moves.
blocks.zh: GLEE竞争对谈判、谈判和说服游戏的经济结果给代理商评分,这些竞争对手是共同的人类和AI对手(Shapira等人,2024年)。 每个游戏家族都需要一名代理商同时制作数字上健全的决定和流利的战略语言. 我们的代理通过模块化架构来处理这些要求:一个古典游戏-理论解析器计算数字决定,一个语言模型随后生成伴随动作的信息.

blocks.en: The solver for each family is grounded in an established theoretical model. Bargaining follows Rubinstein alternating-offers with online estimation of the opponent’s discount factor. Negotiation uses Faratin time-dependent concession, with the opponent’s reservation value updated from hard price rejections. Persuasion implements the Kamenica–Gentzkow disclosure rule, modified by an online estimate of buyer trust in the agent’s signals. The language module selects a rhetorical framing from an evidence-intuition spectrum and five Moral Foundation Theory arms via Thompson sampling, persisting arm preferences across repeated encounters with the same opponent when identity is disclosed.
blocks.zh: 每个家庭的解决者都以既定的理论模式为基础。 Rubinstein 与对手折扣率的在线估算互换报价。 谈判使用法拉廷时间独立的特许权,对手的保留价值从硬价格拒绝中更新. 劝导执行卡梅尼卡-根茨科披露规则,该规则经网上估计买方对代理人信号的信任而修改。 语言模块通过Thompson取样,从证据-内涵谱和5个道德基础理论臂中选择一个言辞框架,在身份被披露后与同一对手的反复遭遇中,始终保持手臂偏好。

blocks.en: While the classical solvers themselves presented few implementation challenges, the dominant challenge was adapting them to opponents whose behavior fell outside the theoretical assumptions of each solver. Several policies that are optimal under their own assumptions produced substantial payoff losses in live games against counterparts who violated those assumptions. We developed guardrails for each such case and validated them on large replays of completed games.
blocks.zh: 虽然古典解答者本身提出的执行挑战很少,但最主要的挑战是将它们适应那些行为超出每个解答者的理论假设的对手. 根据其自己的假设,一些政策是最佳的,对违反这些假设的对手,在现场游戏中造成了巨大的回报损失。 我们为每件案子开发了护栏 并在大型游戏重播时验证

blocks.en: Overall, we contribute a substantial case study of building and evaluating a game-theoretic agent for economic games, showing how classical equilibrium-based strategies can fail when opponents violate their underlying assumptions. We identify concrete failure modes in bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion, and show how opponent modeling, targeted guardrails, and rhetorical framing can mitigate some of these failures while also introducing new trade-offs.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们为建立和评价经济游戏的游戏理论代理人提供了实质性的案例研究,表明在反对者违反其基本假设时,古典平衡战略如何会失败。 我们找出谈判、谈判和说服中的具体失败模式,并表明对手树立模范、目标明确的警戒线和言辞框架如何可以减轻其中一些失败,同时引入新的权衡。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: GLEE ( Shapira et al., 2024 ) scores agents on the economic outcome of bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games. Each family corresponds to a classical model under complete information: alternating-offers bargaining ( Rubinstein, 1982 ) , a refinement of the axiomatic solution of Nash (1950) ; concession-based bilateral trade ( Faratin et al., 1998 ) ; and the disclosure problem ( Kamenica and Gentzkow, 2011 ) . All three assume the opponent’s type is known or drawn from a common prior ( Harsanyi, 1967 ) . GLEE opponents do not supply this information; we estimate the relevant quantity online from observed behavior. Albrecht and Stone (2018) survey opponent-type inference and identify non-stationarity as a core difficulty for approaches that must converge within a single interaction; our shrinkage updates limit the influence of any single observation to address this. Lewis et al. (2017) learn to produce offers and messages jointly; we generate them separately, following the staged approach of Hua et al. (2024) . Bianchi et al. (2024) find that LLM negotiation outcomes depend strongly on surface message tactics, suggesting the value of keeping numeric decisions in a separately grounded component. For the rhetoric layer, Moral Foundations Theory ( Graham et al., 2009 ) supplies five fixed appeals—care, fairness, loyalty, authority, and purity—making the choice of framing a finite-armed bandit that we solve with Thompson sampling ( Chapelle and Li, 2011 ) .
blocks.zh: GLEE(Shapira等人,2024年)对谈判、谈判和说服游戏的经济结果给代理人打分。 每个家庭在完整信息下都与古典模式相对应:交替出价谈判(Rubinstein,1982年),纳什定理解决方案的完善(1950年);基于特许权的双边贸易(Faratin等人,1998年);以及披露问题(Kamenica和Gentzkow,2011年)。 三者都假设对手的类型是已知的或来自共同的前身(Harsanyi,1967年). GLEE反对者不提供这一信息;我们从观测到的行为在线估计相关数量. 阿尔布雷希特和斯通(2018年)调查对手型推论,将非站立性确定为必须在单一相互作用中汇合的方法的核心难题;我们的缩水更新限制了任何单一观测对解决这个问题的影响. Lewis等人(2017年)学习联合提出要约和信息;我们按照Hua等人(2024年)的分阶段办法,分别提出要约和信息. Bianchi等人(2024年)发现LLM谈判结果在很大程度上取决于表面消息策略,建议将数字决定保留在一个单独的基础成分中的价值. 道德基础理论(Graham et al.,2009年)提供了5项固定的呼吁——关怀、公平、忠诚、权威和纯洁——从而选择建立一个有限武装的强盗,我们用Thompson的抽样来解决(Chapelle和Li,2011年)。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: The agent runs one strategy function per game family behind a dispatcher that routes each game to the right one. Within a family, a classical solver produces numeric moves while a language model produces accompanying messages. Derivations and guardrails for degenerate cases are in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 代理机在调度员后,每个游戏家族运行一个策略功能,将每个游戏引导到右侧. 在家族内部,一个古典解析器产生数动,而一个语言模型则产生伴随的信息. 堕落病例的衍生物和护栏载于附录A。

blocks.en: 3.3 The message layer
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 信件层

blocks.en: We use a language model to generate an accompanying message for each move, up to two thousand characters. We model opponent profiles on two components: whether the opponent argues using evidence-based or intuition-based language, and which of the five moral foundations they lean on. We then condition the framing of replies on this profile. A Thompson sampling bandit over those five foundations selects the framing to lead with: each arm maintains a Beta posterior over its success rate, the agent draws from each posterior and plays the highest draw, then updates the chosen arm on the observed outcome. When opponent identity is disclosed, which occurs in roughly half of games, the bandit state is stored per opponent and reloaded on the next encounter. We describe the message layer methodology in more detail in Appendix D , with qualitative examples in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们使用一种语言模型来生成每个动作的随附信息,最多可达到两千个字符. 我们模拟对手在两个部分的简介:对手是使用基于证据还是基于直觉的语言进行论证,以及他们所依赖的五个道德基础中的哪一个. 然后,我们以这一概况作为确定答复框架的条件。 一个汤普森取样强盗在这五个地基上选择了框架来领导:每只手臂保持一个Beta后继器,以超过它的成功率,代理从每个后继器中抽取并演奏最高的画幅,然后将选定的手臂更新到观察到的结果上. 当对手身份被披露,这在大约一半的游戏中发生时,匪盗状态被存储每个对手,并在下一次遭遇时重新加载. 我们在附录D中更详细地描述了信息层方法,在附录E中提供了定性实例。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate the agent on the live leaderboard, in a Monte Carlo suite against synthetic opponents, in an ablation of the opponent-modeling layer, and in an analysis of rhetorical framing in live games.
blocks.zh: 我们评价在现场指挥板上的特工, 在蒙特卡洛套房中对抗合成对手, 在对对手模型层的破坏中, 在对现场游戏中的言语框架的分析中。

blocks.en: We built 11 11 archetypes spanning a range from the hardliner , which holds a fixed extreme position, to the bayesian_rational , which best-responds to public information, and ran the deployed code against each for 400 400 trials per family ( 13,200 13{,}200 games; Appendix B ). Median score falls as an archetype’s behavior departs from the assumptions the relevant solver targets (Figure 1 b; full tables in Appendix C ): the bayesian_rational yields our highest medians, for example + 0.478 +0.478 in bargaining, while the hardliner in negotiation is the only negative median ( − 1.0 -1.0 ), since agreement there requires our reservation value to fall inside a fixed demand, which randomized value assignment rarely produces. blocks.en: We classified 9,337 outgoing persuasion messages, 4,661 bargaining and 7,558 negotiation messages by dominant moral foundation, and tested independence between framing and outcome per family (Appendix D.1 ). The association is strongly game-dependent. In persuasion, buy rate rises from 30.9% under care to 65.8% under loyalty ( χ 2 = 616.7 \chi^{2}=616.7 , p ≈ 3.7 × 10 − 132 p\approx 3.7\times 10^{-132} ; χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 263.5 \chi^{2}(4)=263.5 with standard errors clustered by game). Part of care’s deficit comes from the success definition: 50.1% of care messages are honest “pass” messages, which a buyer should decline (Table 2 ). Restricted to pitches, the care–loyalty gap narrows from 34.8 to 18.6 points (odds ratio 2.18 2.18 for loyalty against care, controlling for quality and round), and on true bluffs, pitches on low-quality rounds, care reaches 59.6% against loyalty’s 73.5%. Bargaining shows the same frame ranking over a much narrower spread ( χ 2 = 11.2 \chi^{2}=11.2 , p = 0.0249 p=0.0249 , Cramér’s V = 0.05 V=0.05 ), and negotiation shows no significant association ( χ 2 = 9.1 \chi^{2}=9.1 , p = 0.059 p=0.059 ), with acceptance between 2.8% and 5.1% regardless of frame. The pattern tracks how directly each family ties its outcome to language: persuasion’s outcome is a trust decision the buyer can reach only through the seller’s words, negotiation turns on a price already on the table, and bargaining sits between them. The evidence–intuition register shows the same ordering. In persuasion, evidence-leaning messages succeed 62.4% of the time against 47.6% for balanced and 44.1% for intuition-leaning ones (odds ratio 1.83 1.83 per unit of evidence-leaning with controls, 2.11 2.11 on true bluffs), while bargaining ( 0.98 0.98 ) and negotiation ( 0.88 0.88 ) show no association. All of these are correlational, since the bandit chose framings adaptively. Appendix E gives qualitative examples in which the message layer adopts an opponent’s rhetorical register and reverses its evaluative direction, which we label counter-framing.

blocks.en: The competition scores an agent on an opponent-adjusted percentile that stabilizes only over many games, so we validated every change on large replays of completed games rather than on one or two live results. We discovered the same pattern during this process: a policy that is optimal under its solver’s assumptions frequently loses to certain opponent behaviors the design had not anticipated. We describe the divergences that drove the most change in our model, the guardrails they produced, and how we keep deployed behavior aligned with design. Figures are in GLEE payoff units; constants are included in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 比赛给对手调整的百分位数打分 稳定在很多游戏上 所以我们验证了完成游戏的大型重播 而不是一两个现场结果的每个变化 在这个过程中,我们发现了同样的模式:在其解决者的假设下最理想的政策经常输给设计没有预料到的某些对手行为。 我们描述了驱动我们模型最变化的分歧, 它们产生的护栏,以及我们如何保持部署的行为与设计一致。 数字为GLEE支付单位;常数列入附录A。

blocks.en: Two components of our persuasion model initially treated each round in isolation, which is correct for product quality but is suboptimal against dishonest opponents. As a seller, the Kamenica–Gentzkow bluff rate q ∗ q^{\ast} is derived for a buyer who evaluates each round independently; against live buyers who tracked our signal history, a single discovered bluff suppressed purchasing for the rest of a game at a cost exceeding the round it won. As a buyer, the initial trust model re-explored a seller it had locked out, on the assumption that an unlucky early sample should not permanently condemn a seller, given the independence of product quality from seller behavior. However, over a sample of 102 102 live games, such re-exploration purchases landed a high-quality product 4.2 % 4.2\% of the time, against 76.3 % 76.3\% for purchases from trusted sellers. As a result, we removed re-exploration and capped our own bluff rate in the opening rounds, having tested non-bluffing and more-selective sellers and found that neither improved aggregate replay outcome. This conservative strategy is correctly considered a cost during synthetic testing (Section 4 ), but effectively shielded our agent from deceptive opponents.
blocks.zh: 我们的说服模式的两个组成部分最初是孤立地对待每一轮的,这在产品质量方面是正确的,但对不诚实的对手却不够理想。 作为销售商,卡梅尼卡-Gentzkow虚张声势(q q^{\ast)是为独立评估每一回合的买家所衍生的;相对于追踪我们信号历史的活买家,一个发现的虚张声势压制了对游戏其余部分的购买,其成本超过了它赢得的回合。 作为买方,初始信托模式重新探索了它所锁定的卖方,其假设是,鉴于产品质量独立于卖方的行为,不幸运的早期样品不应永久谴责卖方。 然而,在102 102个直播游戏的样本中,这种再勘探购买在当时的4.2%的4.2%的优质产品上市,而从信任的销售者那里购买的则有76.3%的76.3%。 因此,我们取消了重新探索,并在开局回合中封顶了自己的虚张声势率,测试了非混杂和更具选择性的销售商,发现两者都没有改进总体重播结果. 这种保守策略在合成试验(第4节)期间被正确地视为成本,但实际上保护了我们的代理人免受欺骗对手的伤害。

blocks.en: In bargaining, one self-ask from the opponent moved our posterior mean over their discount factor from the grid average of 0.819 0.819 to 0.92 0.92 , because that observation lay far from any patient candidate, and the jump turned a fair opening into a large concession. The opponents that triggered it were erratic or trend-reversing, offering little stationary signal about a fixed type. We now shrink each posterior update toward its pre-update value by a factor that decays as observations accumulate, which cut mean absolute error against an off-grid rational opponent from 0.053 0.053 to 0.023 0.023 after three consistent observations. The first update is identical to the earlier fixed-prior shrinkage, so the original incident survives as a reproducible unit test.

blocks.en: Several of the synthetic archetypes in Section 4 began as behaviors we first met in live play, among them the history-tracking buyer behind the bluff cap and the trend-reversing bargainer behind the shrinkage step. Reproducing them synthetically confirmed that the divergences above were recurring archetypes rather than isolated games, and it grounds the Monte Carlo gradient: performance falls smoothly as an opponent departs from a solver’s assumptions because those departures are the cases the guardrails target. We continued this loop throughout the duration of the competition by replaying recently completed games to locate a divergence, encoding the opponent behavior as both a synthetic archetype and a unit test, and retaining a proposed fix when it improves aggregate replay outcome (Table 3 ). Modifications that did not improve aggregate replay outcome were removed and are recorded in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 第4节中的几种合成型开始于我们第一次在现场演出中遇到的行为,其中包括虚张声势的买家和缩水步骤背后的扭转趋势的讨价还价者。 以合成方式复制它们证实,上述差异是反复出现的老式游戏,而不是孤立的游戏,这为蒙特卡洛梯度提供了依据:对手偏离解答者的假设时表现平稳,因为这些偏离是护栏目标。 在整个比赛期间,我们通过重放最近完成的游戏来定位差异,将对手的行为编码为合成型和单位测试,并在改进汇总重播结果时保留一个拟议固定(表3). 未能改善总体重播结果的修改被删除,并记录在附录A中。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: The framing analysis is correlational: the bandit chose framings adaptively, the language model sets the surface wording, and foundation and register labels are lexical. Standard errors are clustered by game because opponent identity is not recorded in the game index, so repeated opponents are not accounted for. A randomized intervention that fixes the framing would be needed to establish a causal effect. The synthetic archetypes are our own construction, and the ablation is only run against them; live contribution of each opponent-estimation module is not measured. Because identity is disclosed in roughly half of games and opponents are typically met only once or twice, cross-game learning rarely engages. Finally, our live standing was modest: peak ratings were 1996.4 in bargaining and 1941.9 in persuasion, 2131.1 in negotiation, and we finished 55th of 198 teams.

blocks.en: The infinite-horizon share x ∗ x^{\ast} discussed in Section 3.1 is the stationary subgame-perfect equilibrium of Rubinstein [1982] , generalized to asymmetric discount factors δ me \delta_{\mathrm{me}} and δ opp \delta_{\mathrm{opp}} ; the equilibrium share depends on these factors because the more patient player has greater bargaining power. For a finite, known horizon we compute the proposer’s take by backward induction from the deadline, where the player who would propose at the final round can claim the whole pot if reached. Pure backward induction oscillates by round parity when a discount factor is near one. We therefore damp the finite value toward the infinite-horizon value using a weight that decays as the deadline recedes, so the exact finite-horizon result dominates only near the deadline. A discount factor within one part in a thousand of one is treated as the degenerate limit and routed through the stable infinite-horizon formula in both the finite and infinite cases. We also cap the agent’s proposed and accepted shares between 30% and 70% in degenerate or unlimited-horizon games, where the raw formula can produce extreme values. In ordinary finite games, we use the exact share derived by backward induction. A deadline safety zone, entered a fixed number of rounds before a known deadline and near the unlimited-horizon hidden round cap we observed around round 99 99 to 100 100 , has the agent mirror the opponent’s last stated position and accept any net-positive offer at the true last chance, which prevents a theoretically justified holdout from ending in the zero-payoff outcome that a missed deadline forces.

blocks.en: The concession target discussed in Section 3.1 is the time-dependent tactic of Faratin et al. [1998] . The progress variable uses elapsed rounds rather than the current round index, so a one-shot ultimatum does not register as fully time-elapsed on its only move. The opponent-value interval tightens only from a hard rejection, as described in Section 3.2 ; a counteroffer is treated as a biased signal and does not tighten the bound. When the opponent’s offer has been stationary for several rounds and is already profitable, the agent accepts it rather than continuing to push, since this family has no per-round decay and the only way a stuck negotiation ends is a walk-away.
blocks.zh: 第3.1节讨论的特许权目标是Faratin等人[1998年]的视时间而定的战术。 进度变量使用经过的回合而不是目前的回合指数,所以一发最后通牒不会登记为唯一一次行动时已完全时滞。 如第3.2节所述,对手-值间距只从硬拒绝中收紧;反价被视为带有偏见的信号,不收紧约束。 当对手的报价已经固定了几轮并且已经有利可图时,代理商会接受而不是继续推动,因为这个家族没有每轮的衰败,而卡住谈判的结局的唯一方式就是离开。

blocks.en: The bluff rate discussed in Section 3.1 is the disclosure policy of Kamenica and Gentzkow [2011] under the game’s payoff structure. When the seller does not know the buyer’s value v v , the agent cannot compute q ∗ q^{\ast} exactly and instead adjusts its bluff rate toward whatever keeps the observed buyer accept-rate consistent with a credible seller. The trust-building cap of Section 5 limits the bluff rate in the first three rounds regardless of q ∗ q^{\ast} .

blocks.en: We initially had the buyer’s trust model re-explore untrustworthy sellers, on the theory that quality is drawn independently each round, so an early unlucky sample should not cause a permanent lockout. Replayed against 102 102 completed games, those re-exploration purchases landed a high-quality product 4.2 % 4.2\% of the time, against 76.3 % 76.3\% for purchases from trusted sellers. The premise was wrong: product quality is independent across rounds, but a seller’s honesty is a fixed trait of that opponent, so re-testing a seller already shown to be unreliable simply loses again. We removed the mechanism, and results presented in the paper come from after this removal.

blocks.en: The taxonomy is our own construction, drawing on behavioral types described in the negotiation literature [ Raiffa, 1982 , Faratin et al., 1998 ] and on tit-for-tat as introduced by Axelrod [1984] . Each archetype observes the agent’s actual move each round and computes its own response. Bargaining and negotiation archetypes expose a rule for the price or share they propose and a rule for whether they accept; persuasion archetypes expose a rule for the seller’s signal or the buyer’s purchase.

blocks.en: We perform a correlational analysis on the effectiveness of rhetoric framing on game success. The bandit chooses each framing from prior outcomes and, when available, opponent identity, so game state and the agent’s own confidence may confound the association. blocks.en: The three families diverge sharply. Persuasion shows an overwhelming association between framing and outcome ( χ 2 = 616.7 \chi^{2}=616.7 , p = 3.7 × 10 − 132 p=3.7\times 10^{-132} ): buy rate more than doubles from care to loyalty , consistent with persuasion being fundamentally a signaling game in which the buyer has no direct access to quality and must read the seller’s language itself. Bargaining shows a real but far smaller effect ( χ 2 = 11.2 \chi^{2}=11.2 , p = 0.0249 p=0.0249 ), with the same qualitative ranking (loyalty highest, authority lowest) but a much narrower spread (12–18%), suggesting framing shifts acceptance odds only modestly once a concrete numeric offer is on the table. Negotiation shows no significant association ( χ 2 = 9.1 \chi^{2}=9.1 , p = 0.059 p=0.059 ) despite the largest sample of the three, with acceptance rates clustered tightly between 2.8 % 2.8\% and 5.1 % 5.1\% regardless of frame – here the offer’s price appears to dominate whatever rhetoric accompanies it. The pattern tracks how directly each game ties outcome to language: persuasion’s outcome is a pure trust decision, negotiation’s is a pure price decision, and bargaining sits in between.
blocks.zh: 三个家庭差异很大。 劝导显示, 框架与结果之间有着压倒性的联系(\\ 2 = 616.7\ chi2\ = 616.7, p = 3.7 × 10 – 132 p = 3. 7\ times 10\ = 132): 购买率从谨慎到忠诚, 谈判显示出一个实际但小得多的效果( 2 = 11.2\chi2}=11.2,p = 0.0249),质量排名相同(忠诚最高,权威最低),但差幅要小得多(12–18 %),说明一旦提出具体的数字报价,就只能略微确定班次接受率。 谈判显示,尽管这三者中最大的一个样本,但没有明显的关联(XQ 2 = 9.1\chi =2\9.1,p = 0.059 p= 0.059),接受率紧紧地集中在2.8 % 2.8 % 和 5.1% 5.1 % 之间,不管框架如何 — 此处的报价似乎支配着随附的任何言论。 模式追踪每个游戏的结果如何与语言直接挂钩:说服的结果是纯粹的信任决定,谈判是纯粹的价格决定,谈判是介于两者之间。

blocks.en: We further investigate persuasion in particular, which demonstrates a strong significant correlation between targeted rhetoric framing and game success. To do this, we perform three splits on the dataset to address the idea that the persuasion association could be an artifact of game state rather than of framing. First, splitting by the product’s true quality, the gap between arms is widest on low-quality rounds: care succeeds 19.9% of the time against loyalty’s 69.1% ( n = 1,686 n=1{,}686 ; χ 2 = 398.0 \chi^{2}=398.0 , p ≈ 1.5 × 10 − 88 p\approx 1.5\times 10^{-88} ). Most of this gap reflects message type rather than persuasion: 81% of care messages on low-quality rounds are honest “pass” messages (884 of 1,087), against 10.5% for loyalty (63 of 599), and a buyer declining a pass is the correct outcome. Restricted to true bluffs, i.e. pitches on low-quality rounds, care succeeds 59.6% of the time against loyalty’s 73.5% ( n = 739 n=739 ; χ 2 = 12.8 \chi^{2}=12.8 , p = 3.4 × 10 − 4 p=3.4\times 10^{-4} ), a gap that remains significant but is far smaller (Appendix D.1 ). On high-quality rounds the care–loyalty gap is 42.5% against 64.8% ( n = 3,106 n=3{,}106 ; χ 2 = 139.7 \chi^{2}=139.7 , p ≈ 3 × 10 − 32 p\approx 3\times 10^{-32} ). Second, the association holds independently within early (rounds 1 1 to 6 6 ), middle ( 7 7 to 13 13 ), and late ( 14 14 to 20 20 ) buckets, each with p < 10 − 13 p<10^{-13} , so it is not a time trend. Third, the product-value-to-price ratio across arms lies in 2.03 2.03 to 2.44 2.44 , tight enough that arm choice is not confounded by which configuration it landed in. We note one pattern: care ’s success rate declines monotonically across the three round buckets ( 41.9 % 41.9\% , 31.0 % 31.0\% , 24.2 % 24.2\% ) while loyalty ’s stays near 65 65 to 67 % 67\% . Part of the decline reflects message mix, since the share of care messages that are honest passes rises from 40.5 % 40.5\% in early rounds to 55.0 % 55.0\% in middle rounds and 51.4 % 51.4\% in late rounds (loyalty’s stays at 4 4 to 9 % 9\% ), but care’s pitch-only rate also dips in the late bucket ( 53.0 % 53.0\% to 44.6 % 44.6\% ), which we have not explained. Finally, the authority arm is the smallest in every split ( n = 38 n=38 to 244 244 ) and its rate is the least stable across datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们尤其要进一步调查说服,这说明有目标的言辞与游戏成功之间有着很强的关联。 为了做到这一点,我们在数据集上进行了三场分割,以解决说服协会可能是游戏状态的文物而不是设定的概念. 首先,按产品的真实质量划分,在低质量的回合中,武器间差距最大:护理成功时间为19.9%,而忠诚时间为69.1%(n=1 686n=1{,}686;χ2=398.0=chi^{2}=398.0,p≈1.5×10−88p\10^{88\10^{88}。 这一差距大多反映了信息类型,而不是说服:81%的低质量轮的护理信息是诚实的“通过”信息(1 087次中的884次),而忠诚度为10.5%(599次中的63次),而买家拒绝发证是正确的结果。 以真实的虚张声势,即低质量的回合投出投球,护理成功59.6%的时间与忠诚的73.5%(n=739 n=739;χ2=12.8\chi^{2}=12.8,p=3.4×10−4p=3.4\time 10^{-4}),这一差距仍然很大,但要小得多(附录D.1). 在高质量的轮次中,护理-忠诚差距为42.5%,而64.8%(n = 3,106 n = 3{,}106;\ = 139.7\chi^{2\}139.7,p\ 3 × 10 − 32 p\ 3\times 10\-32})。 其次,协会在早期(回合1至6 6),中间(7至13 13)和晚期(14 14至20 20)的桶,每桶都用p < 10 − 13 p < 10= 13},因此这不是一个时代的趋势。 第三,不同武器之间的产品价值与价格之比为2.032.03比2.442.44,足够紧,臂部的选择并不令人困惑。 我们注意到一种模式:护理的成功率在三个圆桶之间单调下降(41.9% 41.9% , 31.0% 31.0% 24.2% 24.2% ) , 而忠诚度则保持在65-67 % 67)。 部分减少反映了信息组合,因为诚实传递的护理信息比例从早期的40.5%40.5 %上升到中间的55.0%55.0 %和晚期的51.4 %(忠诚停留在44%至9%的9 %),但护理的只投速率也在后期桶中下降(53.0% 53.0 %至44.6 %),我们对此没有解释。 最后,权威臂是每分数中最小的(n = 38 n = 38 = 244 244),它的速率是各数据集中最不稳定的.

blocks.en: We examine how the dominant moral foundation of each message we sent, and its evidence/intuition register, relate to success. Success is defined as in Appendix D: the buyer purchased (persuasion), or the opponent accepted our offer (bargaining, negotiation). A message’s dominant foundation is the one with the most lexicon hits, requiring at least two hits in total. Its register is the share of evidence-based versus intuition-based lexicon hits, ( E − I ) / ( E + I ) (E-I)/(E+I) , with negated hits excluded; we call a message evidence-leaning if this is positive, intuition-leaning if negative, and balanced if zero (including messages with no hits). All analyses are correlational: the bandit chose framings adaptively, and the language model sets the surface wording.
blocks.zh: 我们审视我们发出的每一项信息的主要道德基础及其证据/入门记录与成功的关系。 成功的定义在附录D中:买方购买(劝说)或对手接受我们的提议(劝告、谈判)。 一个信息的主要基础是词汇点击率最高,总共至少需要两次点击。 其登记册是基于证据和基于直觉的词汇点击(E-I)/(E+I)/(E-I)/(E+I)/(E+I)的比例,排除了否定的点击;如果这是正面的,那么我们称之为收集信息的证据,如果是负面的,则称之为直觉,如果是零,则称为平衡(包括没有点击的信息)。 所有分析都是关联性的:土匪以适应性的方式选择了框架,语言模型设定了表面措辞.

blocks.en: Because messages within one game are not independent, we complement the χ 2 \chi^{2} tests of Appendix D with logistic models whose standard errors are clustered by game. Opponent identity is not recorded in the game index, so we cannot cluster by opponent. Intervals are 95% Wilson intervals, and pairwise comparisons use Holm correction.
blocks.zh: 因为一个游戏中的信息不是独立的,所以我们用逻辑模型来补充附录D的QQ 2\chi^{2}测试,其标准错误被游戏分组. 对手身份没有记录在游戏索引中,因此我们不能被对手集群. 间距为95%的Wilson间隔,对偶比较使用Holm校正.

blocks.en: Tables 8 – 10 give success by foundation for each family. Game-clustered joint Wald tests agree with the χ 2 \chi^{2} tests of Appendix D: persuasion χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 263.5 \chi^{2}(4)=263.5 , p = 8.2 × 10 − 56 p=8.2\times 10^{-56} ; bargaining χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 11.1 \chi^{2}(4)=11.1 , p = 0.025 p=0.025 ; negotiation χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 8.9 \chi^{2}(4)=8.9 , p = 0.064 p=0.064 . Cramér’s V V is 0.257 0.257 , 0.049 0.049 and 0.035 0.035 respectively, so the bargaining association is statistically detectable but small, and negotiation shows none. In persuasion, eight of the ten pairwise foundation differences are significant after Holm correction; fairness versus purity ( p = 0.44 p=0.44 ) and fairness versus authority ( p = 0.051 p=0.051 ) are not.

Table 8: Persuasion: buy rate by dominant foundation of the seller’s message ( n = 9,337 n=9{,}337 , χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 616.7 \chi^{2}(4)=616.7 , p = 3.7 × 10 − 132 p=3.7\times 10^{-132} ), with 95% Wilson intervals.
Table 9: Negotiation: offer-acceptance rate by dominant foundation of our offer’s message ( n = 7,558 n=7{,}558 , χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 9.1 \chi^{2}(4)=9.1 , p = 0.059 p=0.059 ), with 95% Wilson intervals.

Table 10: Bargaining: offer-acceptance rate by dominant foundation of our proposal’s message ( n = 4,661 n=4{,}661 , χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 11.2 \chi^{2}(4)=11.2 , p = 0.025 p=0.025 ), with 95% Wilson intervals.

A purchase is only a success when the seller was pitching. About half of persuasion messages labeled care (50.1%) are instead honest “pass” messages (e.g. “pass on this unit…protecting your capital”), compared with 6–17% for the other foundations, and the care lexicon hits are dominated by protect (1,036), safe (971), secure (519) and risk (402). A buyer correctly declining such a message is counted as a failure, which inflates care’s deficit; removing these warning-flavored words from the lexicon leaves only 14 of the 2,125 messages labeled care. We therefore separate pitches (messages that match neither the buyer’s discouraging-phrase list nor “pass on”) from passes (Table 11 ). Among pitches the foundation association remains significant (Wald χ 2 ​ ( 4 ) = 65.1 \chi^{2}(4)=65.1 , p = 2.4 × 10 − 13 p=2.4\times 10^{-13} ) but the care–loyalty gap narrows from 34.8 to 18.6 points, and to 13.9 points on true bluffs, i.e. pitches on low-quality rounds. The pitch/pass split is lexical and should be treated as approximate. It also qualifies the low-quality-round comparison in Appendix D: those rounds include many honest passes, so “persuading against the truth” applies only to the bluff column.
blocks.zh: 购买只有在卖方投出时才算成功。 大约一半贴有“护理”标签的劝说信息(50.1%)是诚实的“传递”信息(例如“通过这个单位......保护你的资本”),而其他基金会的劝告信息为6-17 %,而“护理词汇”点击率则以保护(1 036)、安全(971)、安全(519)和风险(402)为主。 买主正确拒绝这种信息被算作失败,这夸大了护理的不足;从词汇中删除这些警告口味的词语,在2,125条贴上标签的护理信息中只留下了14条。 因此,我们把投球(既不符合买方令人沮丧的口号清单,也不符合 " 通过 " )与通行证(表11)分开。 在投球中,基金会协会仍然重要(Wald QQ 2 (4) = 65.1\chi^{2}(4)=65.1,p = 2.4 × 10 – 13 p=2.4\times 10^{-13}),但关心-忠诚差距从34.8分缩小到18.6分,真正虚张声势的13.9分,即低质量的投球. 投球/通过分法是逻辑性的,应视同近似。 它还对附录D中质量低的回合比较作了限定:这些轮次包括许多诚实的通行证,因此,“与事实相反”只适用于虚张声势的栏目。

blocks.en: Table 11: Persuasion: buy rate for pitches only and for true bluffs (pitches on low-quality rounds), with 95% Wilson intervals. Pass share is the fraction of the foundation’s messages that were honest “pass” messages.
blocks.zh: 表11 劝导:只为投球和真实虚张声势(低质量回合的弹夹)购买率,威尔逊间隔95%. 传票份额是基金会的诚实“传”信息的一小部分。

blocks.en: Table 12 gives odds ratios against care from logistic models. Controlling for product quality and round leaves the ordering unchanged (loyalty 3.98 3.98 , purity 2.78 2.78 , fairness 2.67 2.67 , authority 2.05 2.05 ). Restricted to pitches, the odds ratios shrink to 2.18 2.18 for loyalty, 1.78 1.78 for fairness and 1.70 1.70 for purity, and authority is indistinguishable from care ( 1.11 1.11 ). Adding the value-to-price ratio, which is available only where the seller knew the buyer’s value ( 4,007 4{,}007 pitch messages), does not change the ordering (loyalty 2.00 2.00 , fairness 1.90 1.90 , purity 1.81 1.81 ).

blocks.en: Table 13 reports success by register. In persuasion, evidence-leaning messages succeed more often (62.4%) than balanced messages (47.6%), and intuition-leaning messages less often (44.1%). The association persists with controls for foundation, quality, round and message length (odds ratio 1.83 1.83 per unit of evidence-leaning, 95% CI 1.63 1.63 – 2.05 2.05 ), among pitches only ( 1.70 1.70 , 1.50 1.50 – 1.93 1.93 ), and is strongest on true bluffs ( 2.11 2.11 , 1.68 1.68 – 2.64 2.64 ). In bargaining ( 0.98 0.98 , 0.75 0.75 – 1.27 1.27 ) and negotiation ( 0.88 0.88 , 0.64 0.64 – 1.20 1.20 ) there is no association, matching the family ordering of Section 4 . Register and foundation are correlated (82% of authority messages lean toward evidence versus 25% of care messages), and the pattern is not monotone in persuasion since intuition-leaning messages do worse than balanced ones, so we do not claim an independent register effect beyond what these controls show.
blocks.zh: 表13按登记册报告成功情况。 在说服方面,收集证据的信息比平衡的信息(47.6%)更常见(62.4%),收集直觉的信息较少(44.1%)。 该协会坚持对地基、质量、圆和电文长度进行控制(每股取证据1.83比,95%CI 1.631.63 – 2.05 2.05),只在投球中(1.70 1.70,1.50 1.50 – 1.93 1.93),在真正的虚张声势上最强(2.11 2.11,1.68 1.68 – 2.64 2.64)。 在讨价还价(0.98 0.98,0.75 0.75 – 1.27 1.27)和讨价还价(0.88 0.88,0.64 0.64 – 1.20 1.20)中,没有关联,符合第4节的家庭订单. 登记和基础是相互关联的(82%的当局信息倾向于证据,25%的护理信息则倾向于证据),这种模式并不是一成不变的,因为寻找直觉的信息比平衡的信息更糟糕,因此我们并不声称存在超出这些控制显示的独立登记效应。

blocks.en: Table 13: Success rate by the register of our message. The last row gives the odds ratio per unit of evidence-leaning from a logistic model with foundation dummies and message length (and, for persuasion, quality and round), clustered by game.

blocks.en: Appendix E Illustrative Rhetorical Counter-Framing Examples
blocks.zh: 附录E 说明性反分裂实例

blocks.en: The following examples illustrate how the message layer sometimes counter-frames an opponent’s rhetorical register rather than simply repeating a fixed appeal. In each case, the response adopts terminology introduced by the opponent and reverses its evaluative direction. These examples are qualitative illustrations and are not used as independent evidence for the statistical results in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 以下的例子说明信息层有时会反面设定对手的口头记录,而不是简单地重复固定的呼吁。 在每一种情况下,答复都采用对手采用的术语,并颠倒其评价方向。 这些实例是定性说明,不作为附录D中统计结果的独立证据。

blocks.en: E.1 Direct Rebuttal of a Fairness Claim
blocks.zh: E.1 公平索赔的直接答辩

blocks.en: Bargaining, b45e8d97 , Round 6.
blocks.zh: 谈判,b45e8d97,第6轮。

blocks.en: Opponent: “I’m offering a significant portion, leaving you with a substantial share. This is a fair split considering the total value at stake.” Response: “Calling a 70% share ‘fair’ undermines the integrity of this negotiation. Let’s make an honest, clean deal: I am offering you $4,145… Accepting a genuine compromise now preserves what remains before further inflation corrupts the value.”
blocks.zh: 反对者:“我提供相当一部分, 考虑到所涉总价值,这是公平的分割。” 回应: " 要求70%的份额`公平 ' 损害了谈判的完整性。 让我们做一个诚实、干净的交易: 我给你4,145美元... 接受真正的妥协,现在保留了在通货膨胀进一步腐蚀这一价值之前剩下的东西。 “

blocks.en: The response directly challenges the opponent’s fairness frame and appropriates the same normative vocabulary to support a different allocation. Rather than accepting “fair” as a characterization of the proposed split, it recasts fairness as an “honest” and “clean” compromise.
blocks.zh: 应对措施直接挑战对手的公平框架,并采用同样的规范词汇来支持不同的分配. 它不接受将“公平”定性为拟议的分割,而是将公平重新定性为“诚实”和“干净”的妥协。

blocks.en: E.2 Authority as a Counter-Frame to Fairness
blocks.zh: E.2 反公平权威

blocks.en: Bargaining, 28ccc457 , Round 22.
blocks.zh: 谈判,28ccc457,第22轮。

blocks.en: Opponent: “I’m offering a fair split, taking slightly less than half.” Response: “Backtracking your demands in round 21 disregards sound bargaining principles. Proven negotiation protocol establishes $373,582 as the authoritative, credible share… Align with this expert benchmark.”
blocks.zh: 反对者 : “ 我提议公平分钱, 答复:“在第21轮中重新提出你的要求无视合理的谈判原则。 经证实的谈判协议确定373 582美元为权威,可信的份额. . 与这一专家基准保持一致。 “

blocks.en: Here the response shifts the basis of legitimacy from the opponent’s claim of “fairness” to an asserted authority-based benchmark. The terms “proven,” “authoritative,” and “credible” construct an expert register and present the proposed value as grounded in an external bargaining standard.
blocks.zh: 在此,答复将合法性的基础从对手的 " 公平 " 主张转变为所谓的以权威为基础的基准。 “经证明的、”“授权的”和“可信的”这些术语构建了一个专家登记册,并提出了以外部谈判标准为基础的拟议价值。

blocks.en: E.3 Matching an Evidence-Based Negotiation Register
blocks.zh: E.3 匹配循证谈判登记册

blocks.en: Negotiation, 1c6db98e , Round 4.
blocks.zh: 谈判,1c6db98e,第4轮。

blocks.en:
Opponent: “…aligning with industry standards and market
conditions .” Response: “…ignores established commercial standards and fails to reflect standard market benchmarks. Industry valuation data in this sector indicates transactions clear much closer to the cost basis.”
blocks.zh:
反对者:“......符合行业标准和市场
答复:“......定居者确立了商业标准,未能反映标准市场基准。 这一部门的行业估值数据表明,交易明显接近成本基础。 “

blocks.en: The response mirrors the opponent’s evidence-heavy register while reversing its substantive conclusion. “Industry standards,” “market conditions,” and “valuation data” establish a shared evidentiary frame, but the response invokes the same frame to argue for a substantially different price.
blocks.zh: 答复反映了对手的证据密集记录,同时推翻了它的实质性结论。 “工业标准”、“市场条件”和“估价数据”确立了一个共同的证据框架,但该答复援引了同一框架来证明价格大不相同。

blocks.en: E.4 Reversing Purity and Fairness Language
blocks.zh: E.4 扭转纯洁和公平语言

blocks.en: Bargaining, f3efe6da , Round 6.
blocks.zh: 谈判,f3efe6da,第6轮。

blocks.en:
Opponent: “…I want to be straightforward rather than theatrical… I
want to make this simple and fair…” Response: “Repeating identical boilerplate undermines the integrity of honest bargaining. A genuine, uncorrupted negotiation
reflects actual strategic asymmetry, not dogmatic posturing… rather than poisoning the deal.”
blocks.zh:
反对者:"......我想直截了当,而不是戏剧...... 页:1
想要让这个简单公正......” 答复:“重复同样的锅炉板会损害诚实谈判的完整性。 真正的、没有被腐蚀的谈判
反映实际战略不对称,而非教条主义姿态...... 而不是毒害协议。 “

blocks.en: The response appropriates the opponent’s purity- and fairness-coded language and turns it against the opponent’s negotiating behavior. Terms such as “integrity,” “genuine,” and “uncorrupted” establish a standard against which repetitive or rigid bargaining is characterized as inconsistent with an authentic negotiation.
blocks.zh: 反应适合对手的纯洁和公平编码语言,并与对手的谈判行为相对应. “完整性”、“真正”和“不腐败”等术语确立了一种标准,据此,重复或僵硬的谈判被定性为与真正的谈判不符。

blocks.en: E.5 Interpretation
blocks.zh: E.5 口译

blocks.en: Across these examples, the message layer can condition the surface realization of a selected frame on the opponent’s preceding rhetoric. The resulting behavior is best characterized as rhetorical counter-framing : the response preserves salient concepts from the opponent’s message while changing their evaluative target. This provides a qualitative complement to the quantitative framing analysis in Appendix D , which tests associations between moral-foundation framing and subsequent outcomes but does not directly measure rhetorical adaptation.
blocks.zh: 通过这些例子,信息层可以将选定框架的表面实现以对手先前的言辞作为条件。 由此产生的行为最好被定性为修辞式反香:反应在改变对手的评价目标的同时保留了来自对手信息的显著概念. 这为附录D中的定量框架分析提供了质的补充,该分析测试了道德基础框架与随后结果之间的关联,但没有直接衡量修辞适应。
